description:
Problem 1 (confirmed): issue #3030 flags PR #2915 although a valid stand-in (2026-10-15T00:09:40Z) preceded the merge (11:36Z) and the only later oracle review (06:01:21Z, state COMMENTED, body 'oracle-verdict: pending', all reviewers absent) carries no success or failure verdict. _project/scripts/soundness_merge_digest.py:147-157,193-194 treats any non-PENDING/DISMISSED review as starting the stand-in window; the gate _project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py:87-96,129-131 starts it only at the latest decisive (success/failure) verdict, which PR #2769 records as intended behavior.
Problem 2 (confirmed): gap issues are never re-evaluated or closed (open_gap_issues, soundness_merge_digest.py:536-560); closure is manual and the digest only recognises 'External review:' on PR comments, so seven issues were bulk-closed in 18 seconds with identical text (#2662-#2667, #2774) and no machine-readable evidence.
Decision D2: re-evaluate OPEN gap issues each run; close with an evidence comment when the entry no longer needs attention, or when an authorized attester (STANDIN_ATTESTERS) posts 'External review: <codex|muse|agy>' on the gap issue; issue body states the reason class (override of an oracle High finding / deferred finding / no review signal).
Do NOT narrow which threads are flagged: verified #3081/#3084 (oracle High overridden by the author) and #2769 (Medium/Low/P2 deferred to the PR description) are the digest's intended targets; the subagent idea 'count only threads without a reply' is rejected.
Constraints: share the decisive-verdict logic with the gate by import or one shared helper (no copied logic); do not change STANDIN_ATTESTERS membership or the soundness path list; read-only record of who the attesters are goes in context; never touch closed issues; no stand-in or external-review comments by the agent (G4).
